description: SAP landscape inventory — source of truth for all SRE Agent skills. Upload this file to the SRE Agent Knowledge Sources after filling in your systems.
how_to_generate: Option 1: Fill this template manually based on your SAP landscape
Option 2: Ask the SRE Agent: 'Build SAP landscape inventory from Azure Resource Graph'
Option 3: Ask the SRE Agent: 'Import SAP landscape from CSV' and paste your data
Option 4: The config proxy registry endpoint returns this data automatically if the collector cron job is configured
